questions.set_intro: Imagine that a friend calls to ask about animals in the home. You talk by phone about whether people should keep a pet.
questions.question: Do you have a pet now, or have you had one before?
questions.model_answer: I do not have a pet right now. I had a small dog as a child, and my parents did most of the daily care.

questions.set_intro: Imagine that a friend calls to ask about animals in the home. You talk by phone about whether people should keep a pet.
questions.question: What daily care do you think a pet needs? Why does that matter?
questions.model_answer: A pet needs food, clean water, exercise, and some company every single day. Skipping those basics for too many hours is unfair to the animal.

questions.set_intro: Imagine that a friend calls to ask about animals in the home. You talk by phone about whether people should keep a pet.
questions.question: Would you recommend that a busy student keep a pet? Why or why not?
questions.model_answer: I would not recommend a pet to a busy student unless that student is home often and has saved money for food and a vet. A dog, for example, cannot spend the whole day alone in an empty room. During exams or trips home, someone reliable must be ready to help. Helping to care for a neighbor's pet might be a better way to start.

questions.question: Do you think students should take a year off before starting university? Explain your view with reasons and one example.
questions.model_answer: I do not think every student should take a year off before university. A year with no plan can be expensive, and some students lose the study habits they built in high school, which makes the first semester harder. A year off is a good idea only when it has a clear purpose, such as working to save tuition, learning a language, or caring for a family member. A friend of mine spent a year coaching at a summer camp and then started university more sure of her major. Without a purpose like that, I would tell a student to begin on time and use the long breaks for work or travel instead. A planned year can help, but an empty year usually does not.
